threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'the Overground' when taking that shiny orange train to Hackney Central. Been there, mate.
Caught a guy singing opera on the 59 last night. Deadpan faces all around, but he carried on like he was in Covent Garden. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew it when the scent of grilled kebabs mixed with the sound of street musicians on the corner. It felt like a real community moment.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a bar with an indoor swimming pool where locals sip cocktails while lounging on inflatable unicorns. It's bizarrely perfect.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a real local knows to carry a backup phone charger when waiting for a delayed Muni. It’s as essential as a burrito on a Friday night.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full suit pull out a saxophone during a delay at Civic Center, and it somehow matched the mood of the smoke-filled chaos perfectly.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists flock to Park Güell, but they miss the quiet charm of Plaça del Sol – where locals sip café amb llet and gossip among the trees.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their reluctance to embrace the midday siesta; they're still buzzing around noon like it’s rush hour.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'Clissold Park' instead of 'the park' like everyone else. And good luck finding your way around without Google Maps.
Last night on the 63, a guy serenaded the driver with a ukulele. Entire bus was awkwardly clapping along while trying to pretend they weren't.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh curry from the corner stand mixed with the sound of a saxophonist on the street—only in Neukölln do those two collide so beautifully.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a club where the bathroom has a dance floor. You think it's a queue, and suddenly you're in a rave while waiting to pee!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they casually dodge tourists blocking the sidewalk. A true San Franciscan knows they’re just part of the hustle.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo trying to catch the bus while balancing a giant bouquet. Only in SF do formal and frantic coexist like that.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss that the tiny bakeries in Gràcia open late in the morning; locals wait for that fresh pa de xocolata just after 10.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still take photos of every dish served at brunch, not realizing we just call it ‘breakfast’ here.
